2133. Reversing a String Using a Character Array

50

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a word and print it with its characters in reverse order, using a character array and a loop.

Description
Read a string word into a character array using scanf. Find the position of its last character using a loop that stops at the null terminator. Use another loop to print the characters of word starting from the last one and moving backward to the first one.
input_spec: A single word with no spaces.
output_spec: Print the word with its characters in reverse order.
